traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for Story 010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION are satisfied. The `traceability/valid-req-reference` rule implements deep requirement content validation by parsing referenced story files, extracting requirement IDs using a robust pattern that works across sections and list formats, caching results per file, and verifying each `@req` annotation against the extracted IDs. It integrates with existing annotation and file validation by piggybacking on @story/@req comments, uses safe path resolution with protection against traversal and absolute paths, and reports clear, specific ESLint diagnostics (`reqMissing`, `invalidPath`) that include both the missing requirement ID and story path. Tests in `tests/rules/valid-req-reference.test.ts` are explicitly tied to this story and cover valid, missing, and bullet-list scenarios, and behavior is documented in `docs/rules/valid-req-reference.md`. No missing pieces of the specified functionality were found.
